item.title: SPD to roll out new feedback tool for responding officers
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Starting January 12, the Springfield Police Department (SPD) is rolling out a new way to share feedback with them using a new tool, PowerEngage. item.title: Winter warm mode could end with some thunder on Thursday
item.description: Mild temperatures will continue through Wednesday, with a pair of storms bringing rain and thunder on Thursday and Friday, followed by a cold weekend before milder weather returns early next week.

item.title: Two people charged with murder, robbery in Polk County
item.description: Kaidan Lamb and Bryson Francka were arrested in Polk County on second-degree murder charges after a man was found dead in the road in Bolivar in December, with Lamb admitting to running over the victim and Francka allegedly robbing him with an airsoft gun.
